concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-account-holder-status]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms guide to active/suspended/closed account-holder state, Adyen-initiated inheritance and post-settlement split routing by pay-in capability; status guidance is not verification, settlement or payout proof.
warnings: Keep account-holder status distinct from verification and allowed/enabled capabilities. The reason tables are explicitly case-dependent; only Adyen can reverse Adyen-initiated suspension, and closure is permanent.
